label: Arctic
description: Ocean-centred northern polar region, here including the Arctic Ocean, its marginal seas, islands, terrestrial catchments, permafrost, and gateways.

label: Antarctic
description: Continent-centred southern polar region, including Antarctica, its ice sheet and shelves, surrounding islands, and the Southern Ocean.

label: Bipolar
description: A pattern, comparison, or distribution involving both polar regions.

label: Arctic Ocean
description: Small, strongly stratified ocean surrounded by continents and connected to the Pacific and Atlantic through restricted gateways.

label: Southern Ocean
description: Circumpolar ocean surrounding Antarctica and linking the Atlantic, Indian, and Pacific basins.

label: Central Arctic Ocean
description: Deep central basins and ridges of the Arctic Ocean.

label: Fram Strait
description: Deep Atlantic–Arctic gateway between Greenland and Svalbard.

label: West Spitsbergen Current
description: Northward-flowing branch carrying warm Atlantic-origin water through eastern Fram Strait.

label: East Greenland Current
description: Southward flow exporting Arctic-origin water and sea ice along Greenland.

label: Canada Basin

label: Eurasia Basin

label: Amerasia Basin
description: Arctic basin including the Canada and Makarov basins and intervening ridges.

label: Gakkel Ridge
description: Ultraslow-spreading mid-ocean ridge crossing the Eurasia Basin.

label: Lomonosov Ridge
description: Continental ridge separating the Amerasia and Eurasia basins.

label: Greenland
description: Large Arctic island bearing the Greenland Ice Sheet.

label: Svalbard
description: High-Arctic archipelago north of Norway.

label: Storfjordrenna

label: Lake A
description: Meromictic High-Arctic lake on Ellesmere Island containing anoxic, sulfidic relict seawater.

label: Bonanza Creek LTER
description: Interior Alaska boreal–permafrost research site.

label: Qeqertarsuaq, West Greenland
description: Arctic coastal waters influenced by seasonal glacial melt.

label: Siberian Arctic shelves
description: Broad shallow Kara, Laptev, East Siberian, and Chukchi shelf system with strong river, sea-ice, sediment, and Pacific-water influence.

label: Arctic continental slope
description: Narrow transition between broad Arctic shelves and deep central basins; an important boundary-current and nutrient-transport corridor.

label: Antarctica
description: Ice-covered southern continent divided broadly into East and West Antarctica by the Transantarctic Mountains.

label: East Antarctica
description: Predominantly high, old continental-crust sector of Antarctica.

label: West Antarctica
description: Lower-elevation, tectonically complex sector containing marine-based ice-sheet basins.

label: Antarctic Peninsula
description: Maritime Antarctic mountain chain extending toward South America.

label: Ross Ice Shelf
description: Large floating ice shelf fringing the Ross Sea.

label: Mercer Subglacial Lake
description: Hydrologically active lake beneath the West Antarctic Ice Sheet.

label: Marguerite Bay

label: Rothera Time-Series

label: King George Island
description: South Shetland Island with research stations and terrestrial contamination gradients.

label: Deception Island
description: Active volcanic caldera island with geothermal habitats.

label: Livingston Island
description: South Shetland Island with maritime Antarctic soils and glaciers.

label: Maxwell Bay

label: Dome Fuji
description: High East Antarctic plateau region surveyed for subglacial geology and oldest ice targets.

label: Mertz Polynya
description: East Antarctic coastal polynya and site of dense-water formation and intense seasonal production.

label: Western Antarctic Peninsula
description: Rapidly changing coastal and shelf ecosystem west of the Antarctic Peninsula.

label: South Georgia
description: Subantarctic island and productive shelf ecosystem downstream of the Antarctic Circumpolar Current.

label: Marine water column
description: Pelagic seawater from surface to deep ocean.

label: Surface ocean
description: Sunlit or near-surface marine waters.

label: Deep ocean
description: Mesopelagic, bathypelagic, and abyssal waters.

label: Ice-shelf cavity

label: Sea ice
description: Solid ice, brine channels, and associated biological interfaces.

label: Melt pond
description: Seasonal water body on sea ice.

label: Sea-surface microlayer
description: Submillimetre air–water interface.

label: Polar soil
description: Cold, often oligotrophic terrestrial mineral or organic soil.

label: Hydrocarbon-contaminated soil
description: Soil affected by petroleum hydrocarbons and associated nutrient imbalance.

label: Permafrost
description: Ground remaining frozen for at least two consecutive years.

label: Peat soil
description: Organic-rich wetland soil storing substantial carbon.

label: Subglacial lake
description: Liquid-water ecosystem beneath an ice sheet.

label: Glacier foreland
description: Recently deglaciated terrain forming a primary-succession chronosequence.

label: Antarctic geothermal habitat
description: Volcanically warmed soil or sediment within Antarctica.

label: Polar lake
description: Fresh, brackish, or meromictic inland water body.

label: Sponge holobiont
description: Sponge host plus associated bacteria, archaea, and microbial eukaryotes.

label: Marine benthos
description: Seafloor and organisms living on or in it.

label: Coastal polynya
description: Persistent or recurrent open-water area within coastal sea ice.

label: Marine plastisphere
description: Biofilm community colonizing plastic debris.

label: Ice-cap surface
description: Supraglacial snow and ice exposed to light.

label: Marine sediment
description: Deposited seafloor material and porewater habitat.

label: Viruses
description: DNA and RNA viruses, including bacteriophages, archaeal viruses, and eukaryotic viruses.

label: Bacteria
description: Domain Bacteria.

label: Archaea
description: Domain Archaea.

label: Eukaryota
description: Microbial and macroscopic eukaryotes.

description: Class containing tailed double-stranded DNA bacteriophages.

label: Nucleocytoviricota
description: Phylum of large and giant double-stranded DNA viruses infecting eukaryotes.

label: Crassvirales

label: Polinton-like viruses

label: Marseilleviridae
description: Family of giant viruses infecting eukaryotes.

label: Thioglobus

label: Patescibacteria
description: Radiation of bacteria with generally small cells and reduced genomes.

label: Comammox Nitrospira clade B
description: Bacteria capable of complete ammonia oxidation in a single organism.

label: Candidatus Tariuqbacteria
description: Proposed bacterial class from anoxic, sulfidic relict seawater in High-Arctic Lake A.

label: Amylibacter
description: Marine alphaproteobacterial genus associated with late-summer Arctic microbiomes.

label: Pelagibacter
description: Ubiquitous marine SAR11 bacterium with polar genomic adaptations.

label: Diazotrophs
description: Organisms capable of biological dinitrogen fixation.

label: UCYN-A
description: Symbiotic unicellular cyanobacterial diazotroph, Candidatus Atelocyanobacterium thalassa.

label: Diatoms

label: Haptophytes
description: Photosynthetic or mixotrophic eukaryotic plankton including Phaeocystis lineages.

label: Cryptophytes
description: Small flagellated algae often favored in fresher, stratified Antarctic coastal waters.

label: Syndiniales
description: Diverse parasitic dinoflagellates prominent in marine microeukaryotic communities.

label: Cercozoa
description: Diverse protists including heterotrophic and parasitic lineages.

label: Marine stramenopiles (MAST)
description: Mostly heterotrophic marine stramenopile lineages.

label: Antarctic benthic assemblages
description: Diverse and often endemic seafloor fauna and associated communities.

label: Antarctic snow and ice algae
description: Photosynthetic eukaryotes forming visible blooms on snow and ice.

label: Antarctic sponge microbiome
description: Host-associated bacterial, archaeal, and eukaryotic consortia.

label: Viral lysis
description: Virus-mediated rupture and mortality of host cells.

label: Lysogeny
description: Integration or stable maintenance of a viral genome in a host lineage.

label: Viral shunt
description: Release of cellular material to dissolved and particulate pools through viral infection and lysis.

label: Cold adaptation
description: Genomic, biochemical, or physiological adjustment to low temperature.

label: Carbon fixation
description: Biological conversion of inorganic carbon to organic matter.

label: Biological carbon export
description: Transfer of biologically produced carbon from surface waters to ocean interior or sediments.

label: Biological carbon pump
description: Biological production, transformation, and downward transport that stores carbon in the ocean.

label: Nitrogen fixation
description: Conversion of dinitrogen gas to biologically available nitrogen.

label: Nitrification
description: Oxidation of ammonia to nitrite and nitrate.

label: Denitrification
description: Reduction of nitrate/nitrite toward gaseous nitrogen products.

label: Sulfur oxidation
description: Oxidation of reduced sulfur compounds for energy or detoxification.

label: Sulfur and sulfate reduction
description: Anaerobic reduction of sulfur species.

label: Atmospheric trace-gas oxidation
description: Microbial use of gases such as hydrogen or carbon monoxide at low concentration.

label: Primary succession
description: Community establishment on newly exposed substrate.

label: Microbial seasonal succession
description: Recurring taxonomic or functional community change through an annual cycle.

label: Atlantification
description: Increasing Atlantic-water influence and associated physical, chemical, and biological change in the Arctic.

label: Overturning circulation
description: Large-scale density-driven exchange among surface, intermediate, deep, and abyssal waters.

label: Dense-water formation
description: Production and sinking of cold, saline water, often aided by sea-ice brine rejection.

label: Upwelling
description: Vertical movement of deeper water and its dissolved constituents toward the surface.

label: Riverine nutrient and carbon supply
description: Transport of dissolved and particulate material from land to the Arctic Ocean.

label: Coastal-erosion supply
description: Release of carbon, nutrients, and sediment through erosion of Arctic coasts.

label: Chemical weathering
description: Rock and mineral dissolution and alteration that releases solutes.

label: Phytoplankton community reorganization
description: Change in the relative contribution of phytoplankton groups.

label: Prokaryotic antiviral defense
description: CRISPR–Cas and other mechanisms that recognize, restrict, or retain molecular memory of mobile genetic elements.

label: Subglacial drainage
description: Filling, connection, and drainage of water bodies beneath an ice sheet.

label: Snow and ice surface melt
description: Production of liquid water by surface energy absorption and melting.

label: Hydrothermal circulation
description: Seawater circulation through geothermally heated ocean crust and return of heat and reaction products to the ocean.

label: Seafloor spreading
description: Creation and extension of oceanic crust at a divergent plate boundary.

label: Crustal and supercontinent assembly
description: Accretion, collision, rifting, and reworking that construct continental and ocean-basin architecture.

label: Sea-ice cover
description: Extent, concentration, thickness, duration, and seasonality of sea ice.

label: Temperature
description: Thermal state of air, ice, soil, sediment, or water.

label: Salinity
description: Dissolved salt concentration and its contribution to density structure.

label: Light availability and spectrum
description: Amount and spectral quality of photosynthetically available radiation.

label: Freshwater input
description: River, precipitation, sea-ice, iceberg, and glacial meltwater input.

label: Glacial retreat
description: Loss and landward retreat of glacier or ice-sheet margins.

label: Atlantic Water inflow
description: Advection of relatively warm, saline Atlantic-origin water into the Arctic.

label: Hydrocarbon contamination
description: Petroleum-derived environmental disturbance.

label: Oxygen availability
description: Oxic–anoxic gradient structuring aerobic and anaerobic metabolism.

label: pH
description: Acidity/alkalinity condition shaping community composition and mineral chemistry.

label: Moisture availability
description: Liquid-water availability in terrestrial habitats.

label: Water-mass identity
description: Integrated hydrographic setting characterized by temperature, salinity, oxygen, and history.

label: Permafrost thaw
description: Warming and loss of perennially frozen ground.

label: Seafloor bathymetry
description: Depth and shape of shelves, slopes, basins, ridges, sills, and gateways that steer water and modify mixing.

label: Wind forcing
description: Atmospheric stress and heat exchange that move sea ice, open polynyas, and drive ocean circulation.

label: Environmental filtering
description: Deterministic selection of organisms by local physical and chemical conditions.

label: Nitrate
description: Oxidized dissolved inorganic nitrogen source.

label: Ammonium
description: Reduced dissolved inorganic nitrogen source and nitrification substrate.

label: Phosphate
description: Major dissolved inorganic phosphorus source.

label: Silicate
description: Dissolved silicon used by diatoms to build frustules.

label: Iron
description: Trace metal that limits or co-limits much Southern Ocean phytoplankton growth.

label: Manganese
description: Trace metal that can co-limit Southern Ocean phytoplankton growth and nutrient drawdown.

label: Organic carbon
description: Dissolved or particulate reduced carbon serving as substrate and carbon-cycle pool.

label: Dissolved inorganic nitrogen
description: Combined nitrate, nitrite, and ammonium available for transport and biological use.

label: Sulfate
description: Oxidized sulfur anion produced by sulfide weathering and used as an anaerobic electron acceptor.

label: Atlantic Water
description: Relatively warm, saline water entering the Arctic through Fram Strait and the Barents Sea.

label: Pacific Water
description: Water entering the Arctic through Bering Strait, carrying heat and nutrients.

label: Arctic halocline
description: Strong salinity stratification that separates fresh surface water from warmer Atlantic-origin water.

label: Antarctic Circumpolar Current
description: Strong eastward circumpolar current connecting the major ocean basins.

label: Circumpolar Deep Water
description: Relatively warm, nutrient- and carbon-rich Southern Ocean deep water that upwells and can access continental shelves.

label: Antarctic Bottom Water
description: Dense abyssal water formed from Antarctic shelf waters and exported to the global ocean.

label: Antarctic Surface Water
description: Cold upper-ocean water north of the continent and south of the polar front.

label: Antarctic Dense Shelf Water
description: Cold saline shelf water produced partly through sea-ice formation and brine rejection; a precursor to Antarctic Bottom Water.

label: Shotgun metagenomics
description: Untargeted sequencing of community DNA.

label: Viral metagenomics
description: Metagenomics enriched for viral particles or sequences.

label: Metatranscriptomics
description: Community RNA sequencing used to assess expressed genes and active populations.

label: Long-read metagenomics
description: PacBio or nanopore sequencing enabling long genomic assemblies.

label: 16S/18S amplicon sequencing
description: Marker-gene sequencing for community composition.

label: Single-cell genomics
description: Genome amplification and sequencing from individual cells.

label: Hi-C metagenomics
description: Chromosome-conformation capture used to link DNA fragments and mobile elements to genomes.

label: Stable-isotope probing
description: Tracing substrate assimilation using isotopically labeled material.

label: Flow cytometry
description: Particle or cell counting and characterization by optical signals.

label: Ecological network analysis
description: Inference of associations or candidate interactions from co-variation and graph structure.

label: Remote sensing
description: Satellite or airborne observation of surface properties.

label: Ocean biogeochemical modeling
description: Numerical simulation coupling circulation, nutrients, ecosystems, and carbon.

label: Review synthesis
description: Structured synthesis of published observations, experiments, and models.

label: Airborne geophysics
description: Magnetic, radar, gravity, or related measurements collected from aircraft.

label: Sedimentary ancient DNA metabarcoding
description: Recovery and marker-gene analysis of preserved DNA from dated sediment.

label: Diagnostic pigment analysis
description: HPLC pigment measurements and algorithms used to infer phytoplankton groups.

label: Sediment trap
description: Collection of sinking particles to estimate vertical flux.

label: Genome-resolved metagenomic analysis
description: Assembly, binning, and interpretation of metagenome-assembled genomes.

label: Aasiaat coastal region
description: Western Greenland coastal and channel system around Aasiaat used for community-engaged bathymetry and relative sea-level assessment.

label: Bayelva permafrost observatory
description: High-Arctic permafrost and active-layer monitoring area near Ny-Alesund, Svalbard.

label: Gough Island
description: Remote South Atlantic island used for sub-Antarctic wildlife and disease surveillance.

label: Prydz Bay
description: East Antarctic embayment and continental-shelf region used for marine biological and physical observations.

label: Permafrost active-layer soil
description: Seasonally thawed soil above perennially frozen ground.

label: Benthic microbial mat
description: Layered, surface-attached microbial community growing on lake or marine sediment.

label: Polar bear (Ursus maritimus)
description: Arctic marine mammal used in comparative and conservation genomics.

label: Brown bear (Ursus arctos)
description: Holarctic bear lineage compared with polar bears in evolutionary genomics.

label: Great skua (Stercorarius skua)
description: Wide-ranging seabird implicated in movement of avian pathogens among remote islands.

label: H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b
description: Highly pathogenic avian influenza A virus lineage detected in polar and subpolar wildlife.

label: Southern Ocean-to-tropics teleconnection
description: Atmospheric and coupled-ocean pathway by which Southern Ocean forcing influences tropical climate.

label: Transposable-element insertion
description: Integration of a mobile DNA sequence into a genome, potentially changing local regulation or structure.

label: Gene regulation
description: Control of gene expression through promoters, enhancers, untranslated regions, chromatin, and related mechanisms.

label: Relative sea-level change
description: Change in sea-surface height relative to the moving solid Earth at a particular coast.

label: Coastal water exchange
description: Movement and renewal of water, dissolved constituents, and particles through coastal channels and embayments.

label: Phosphorus cycling
description: Biological and geochemical uptake, transformation, storage, and release of phosphorus compounds.

label: Organic-matter degradation
description: Biological breakdown and remineralization of organic substrates.

label: Microbial growth
description: Production of new microbial biomass and DNA following resource or environmental change.

label: Microbial predation and epibiosis
description: Growth supported by attacking, consuming, or attaching to other microbial cells.

label: Seabird movement among islands
description: Foraging, migration, or dispersal movements that can connect remote island populations and pathogens.

label: Climate-model mean-state bias

label: Southern Annular Mode
description: Leading mode of Southern Hemisphere extratropical atmospheric circulation variability.

label: Glacial isostatic adjustment
description: Solid-Earth deformation and gravity change following past and ongoing ice-mass redistribution.

label: Coupled climate modeling
description: Numerical experiments coupling atmosphere, ocean, sea ice, and sometimes ice sheets or land.

label: Whole-genome resequencing
description: Genome-wide sequencing of multiple individuals against one or more reference assemblies.

label: Multibeam bathymetric mapping
description: Ship-based acoustic mapping of seafloor depth and morphology.

label: Community knowledge co-production
description: Research design and interpretation that formally integrates knowledge and priorities of local communities.

label: Integrated multi-omics
description: Joint analysis of genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, metabolomic, or related molecular layers.

label: Quantitative stable-isotope probing
description: Taxon-resolved estimation of growth or substrate incorporation from density shifts in isotope-labeled nucleic acids.

label: Climate reanalysis
description: Dynamically consistent reconstruction combining observations with a numerical weather or climate model.

label: Phylogenetic analysis
description: Reconstruction of evolutionary relationships and candidate dispersal histories from sequence data.

label: Animal movement tracking
description: Telemetry or geolocation used to reconstruct wildlife movements and possible connectivity.

label: Glacial-isostatic-adjustment modeling
description: Numerical modeling of solid-Earth deformation and gravity change caused by ice-mass history.

label: Viral whole-genome sequencing
description: Recovery and comparison of near-complete or complete viral genomes from isolates or clinical and environmental samples.

label: Long-read genome sequencing
description: PacBio HiFi, nanopore, or comparable long-read sequencing used to assemble an organismal reference genome.

label: Antarctic fur-seal gut
description: Host-associated intestinal microbial habitat represented by Antarctic fur-seal fecal material.

label: Jonah's icefish (Neopagetopsis ionah)
description: Hemoglobin-free Antarctic notothenioid fish endemic to the Southern Ocean.

label: Antarctic fur seal (Arctocephalus gazella)
description: Antarctic and sub-Antarctic pinniped whose diet and gut microbiome connect marine and terrestrial coastal ecosystems.

description: Lytic Arctic dsDNA prasinovirus co-isolated with MpoV-44T.A and comparatively abundant in Arctic metagenomes.

label: Chitin degradation

label: Antimicrobial resistance potential

label: Nutrient availability
description: Concentration and form of growth-limiting or supporting nutrients in an organism's environment.

label: Weddell Gyre

label: Ross Sea

label: Amundsen Sea

label: Ny-Ålesund

label: Ofotfjorden

label: Utqiaġvik

label: Bottom sea ice

label: Rotten sea ice

label: Glacial ice

label: Glacier-fed freshwater

label: Fjord

label: Bacteroidia
description: Bacterial class containing abundant degraders of algal and other complex organic matter in polar marine systems.

label: Sea-ice algae

label: Bermanella

label: Pseudoalteromonas
description: Marine gammaproteobacterial genus with metabolically diverse and particle-associated representatives.

label: DMSP cycling

label: Sea-ice algal primary production
description: Photosynthetic carbon fixation by algae living in or attached to sea ice.

label: Turbulent nutrient supply
description: Transport of dissolved nutrients across an interface by turbulence and mixing.

label: Microbial dispersal
description: Movement of microorganisms among connected habitats, followed by possible establishment or loss through environmental filtering.

label: Hydrocarbon degradation
description: Microbial transformation and consumption of petroleum-derived hydrocarbons.

label: Sea-ice melt export
description: Release of cells, aggregates, particulate matter, and dissolved molecules from melting sea ice into seawater.

label: Trace-metal cycling
description: Inputs, biological uptake, scavenging, phase partitioning, and transport of trace metals in marine systems.

label: Turbulence
description: Small-scale fluid motion that enhances mixing and material exchange across ocean and ice interfaces.

label: Sea-ice structure
description: Ice thickness, porosity, brine connectivity, deformation, and void geometry that create microbial habitats and control exchange.

label: Chemical dispersant exposure

label: Thermal stratification
description: Vertical density structure caused by temperature differences and associated water-mass layering.

label: Trace-metal availability
description: Supply and chemical form of micronutrient or contaminant metals that regulate biological uptake and productivity.

label: Dimethylsulfoniopropionate (DMSP)
description: Organosulfur osmolyte and microbial substrate that links stress physiology, sulfur recycling, and dimethyl sulfide production.

label: Environmental-DNA metabarcoding
description: Taxonomic profiling from environmental DNA using amplified genetic marker regions.

label: Primary-production assay

label: Trace-metal analysis
description: Measurement of dissolved and particulate metal concentrations and phase partitioning.

label: Iron-addition incubation
description: Controlled enrichment experiment used to test phytoplankton responses to added iron.

label: Mesocosm experiment
description: Controlled community-level experiment that retains multiple interacting organisms and environmental processes.

label: FT-ICR mass spectrometry
description: Ultrahigh-resolution mass spectrometry used to assign molecular formulae in complex dissolved organic matter.

label: South China Sea
description: Named marginal-sea scope for the cold-seep collection.

label: Haima cold seep
description: Haima seep field and associated sampling areas in the South China Sea.

label: Site F / Formosa Ridge seep

label: Lingshui cold seep
description: Lingshui seep sampling area used in interface-water comparisons.

label: Haiyang 4 seep
description: Named SCS seep area represented in comparative metagenomic datasets.

label: Dongsha / GMGS2 sites

label: Shenhu area
description: SCS gas-hydrate drilling area represented in subseafloor microbial studies.

label: Qiongdongnan Basin
description: SCS basin represented in hydrate and seep microbial datasets.

label: Newborn SCS seep
description: Human-induced methane seep monitored during ecosystem development; retain station-specific metadata.

label: Cold seep

label: Seep water column

label: Seep bottom water

label: Seep sediment–water interface

label: Seep sediment
description: Sediment depth intervals collected in seep-affected areas.

label: Hydrate-bearing sediment

label: Seep host-associated microbiome

label: Seep carbonates and mats
description: Carbonate or mat habitats represented in seep sampling designs.

label: Methylococcales
description: Bacterial order containing methanotrophic populations profiled in seep water and sediment.

description: Methane oxidation associated with oxygen availability.

label: Nitrogen-coupled methane oxidation
description: Methane transformations coupled with nitrate or nitrite metabolism in the inspected studies.

label: Macromolecule fermentation
description: Anaerobic conversion of organic substrates, represented by genomic and transcript evidence.

label: Microbial community assembly
description: Observed community patterns and statistical estimates of ecological assembly.

label: Microbial population evolution
description: Population-genomic variation, recombination, and selection analyses.

label: Microbial defense and viral counter-defense
description: Genes and experiments addressing microbial protection and viral anti-defense.

label: Mercury transformations
description: Mercury methylation, demethylation, and reduction evidence recorded with assay limits.

label: Reductive dehalogenation
description: Reduction-associated removal of halogens from organohalides; genes and experiments are distinguished.

label: Quorum sensing
description: Chemical signaling systems examined using sequence, expression, and experimental evidence.

label: Chemosynthetic symbiosis
description: Host–microbe associations involving chemically fueled microbial metabolism.

label: Seep methane biofilter

label: Quantitative PCR
description: Targeted amplification used to estimate marker-gene abundance.

label: Porewater and water geochemistry
description: Chemical and isotopic characterization of water, sediment, or porewater.

label: Particle-attached/free-living fractionation
description: Operational size separation of water microbial fractions; filter cutoffs are study-specific.

label: Reactive-transport modeling
description: Model-based estimates of sediment reactions and material transport.

label: Microbial cultivation
description: Isolation and physiological examination of cultivable microorganisms.

label: In situ incubation
description: Incubation deployed within the sampled marine environment.

label: Laboratory incubation
description: Controlled experimental exposure outside the original environment.

label: Genome-scale metabolic modeling
